import sys, dis
from reflex.utils.format import length_of_largest_common_substring

TARGET_NAME = 'length_of_largest_common_substring'
TARGET_FILE = length_of_largest_common_substring.__code__.co_filename
TRACK = {'str1','str2','dp','max_length','i','j'}

pairs = set()

defs = {}

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    if event == 'call' and frame.f_code.co_name == TARGET_NAME and frame.f_code.co_filename == TARGET_FILE:
        frame.f_trace_opcodes = True
        # parameters are defined on function entry line
        defs['str1'] = frame.f_code.co_firstlineno
        defs['str2'] = frame.f_code.co_firstlineno
        return tracer

    if frame.f_code.co_name != TARGET_NAME or frame.f_code.co_filename != TARGET_FILE:
        return tracer

    if event == 'opcode':
        code = frame.f_code.co_code
        op = code[frame.f_lasti]
        opname = dis.opname[op]
        if opname in ('LOAD_FAST','STORE_FAST'):
            var_idx = code[frame.f_lasti + 1]
            varname = frame.f_code.co_varnames[var_idx]
            if varname in TRACK:
                line = frame.f_lineno
                if opname == 'STORE_FAST':
                    defs[varname] = line
                else:  # LOAD_FAST
                    d = defs.get(varname)
                    if d is not None:
                        pairs.add((varname, d, line))
    return tracer

sys.settrace(tracer)
res = length_of_largest_common_substring('abracadabra-trace', 'cadabra-trial')
sys.settrace(None)
print('result', res)
for p in sorted(pairs):
    print(p)
